verdict.rationale: QuickBooks docs explicitly cite automated payment reminders, statement reminders for late customers, and A/R aging reports to identify overdue accounts, directly supporting the reminder half of the story. However, recurring invoice setup is never explicitly mentioned in the evidence pack—only general invoice creation/templates are covered—so that half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurring/scheduled invoice creation, independent hands-on confirmation that reminders work as advertised.
